biz_ownership_transfer_id.title: Biz Ownership Transfer Id
biz_ownership_transfer_id.description: The id of the BizOwnershipTransfer to accept. This is provided in the email sent to the new owner, and is set to expire after 1 days.

accept.title: Accept
accept.description: Whether to accept the ownership transfer. If false, the transfer request will be deleted, and nothing will happen.

org_id.title: Org Id
org_id.description: The new org to link the hub to. Must be owned by current user.
